x: We were pleased to see Joe Scammell walking again less than twelve months after he suffered a serious illness. He walked extremely well for his 76 years of age and finished in 74:11 with others still behind him.
It would be wrong to let this occasion pass without mentioning that veteran Belgravian Joe Scammell who finished in 77:31 a useful performance from our oldest active member.
Namely, Bernard Eglinton down from North Wales and Joe Scammell, not getting any younger but competing in the 'D' section and completing 8324m.
Joe Scammell was also a welcome starter who must have walked the race a few times. He is rumoured to be writing to the Merton Borough Council to complain that the hill is getting steeper.
As usual we had good performances from our others, our Vets, led by World Champion Doug Fotheringham with John Bromley and Joe Scammell would surely have beaten any other Clubs trio.

Joe Scammell was our 5th finisher and, had Ron finished, would have gained a National medal. 1.B.Graham(Yorks) 4.24.18; 2.R.Dobson(Ilf.) 4.28.59, 3.R.Dobson(Boundary) 4.34.18....Bels..... 5.S.Marshall 4.41.56, 10.J.Newnham 4.54.43, 24.J.Hall 5.23.50, 41R.Day 5.53.26, 43.J.Scamell 6.02.01,
The National “Junior” walk team was led home by Joe Scammell with the team finishing 3rd. Joe was followed into our teams by his son and grandson Mike.
